#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
NETWORK="etlnetwork" CONTAINER_NAME="dictionaryetl" PORT="8086" HEALTH_URL="http://${CONTAINER_NAME}:${PORT}/actuator/health" OUTFILE="container_ip_address.txt"
fail() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# -- (Note from George): I did not modify this bash function, but it isn't currently working as intended. # -- It would be better to recreate the container each time. This ensures the desired branch is the one # -- that is actually deployed. # -- I am adding this stop & rm. It can be removed/modified at a later date. docker compose down || true
# --- Validate external shared network exists (do NOT recreate it in Jenkins) --- docker network inspect "$NETWORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 \ || fail "Required external Docker network '$NETWORK' does not exist. Create it outside Jenkins."
# --- If container exists and is healthy/up, exit success fast --- if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "$CONTAINER_NAME"; then # If the image has a HEALTHCHECK, prefer that signal hc="$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" \ | jq -r '.[0].State.Health.Status // empty' || true)"
if [[ "$hc" == "healthy" ]]; then ip="$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" | jq -r '.[0].NetworkSettings.Networks["'"$NETWORK"'"].IPAddress // empty')" [[ -n "$ip" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$ip" > "$OUTFILE" || true echo "$CONTAINER_NAME is already running and healthy." exit 0 fi
# No healthcheck or not healthy: verify DNS+HTTP from within the shared network if docker run --rm --network "$NETWORK" curlimages/curl:8.6.0 \ sh -lc 'getent hosts "'"$CONTAINER_NAME"'" >/dev/null && curl -fsS --max-time 3 "'"$HEALTH_URL"'" >/dev/null' then ip="$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" | jq -r '.[0].NetworkSettings.Networks["'"$NETWORK"'"].IPAddress // empty')" [[ -n "$ip" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$ip" > "$OUTFILE" || true echo "$CONTAINER_NAME is already running and reachable." exit 0 fi
echo "$CONTAINER_NAME is running but not healthy/reachable; will attempt to (re)start via compose." fi
# --- Not running (or unhealthy): bring it up --- docker compose up -d --build
# --- Validate it came up and is reachable via DNS --- # Wait briefly for DNS/health to settle (bounded retries, not an infinite wait) for _ in {1..20}; do if docker run --rm --network "$NETWORK" curlimages/curl:8.6.0 \ sh -lc 'getent hosts "'"$CONTAINER_NAME"'" >/dev/null && curl -fsS --max-time 3 "'"$HEALTH_URL"'" >/dev/null' then ip="$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" | jq -r '.[0].NetworkSettings.Networks["'"$NETWORK"'"].IPAddress // empty')" [[ -n "$ip" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$ip" | tee "$OUTFILE" >/dev/null || true echo "$CONTAINER_NAME started and is reachable." exit 0 fi sleep 1 done
fail "$CONTAINER_NAME did not become reachable at $HEALTH_URL on network $NETWORK"
